query:
SELECT categoryId, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM blog_posts WHERE status='published' GROUP BY categoryId ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) as null_category FROM blog_posts WHERE status='published' AND categoryId IS NULL;
